An agent can discover what a website"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" does, supply the right arguments, and call its tools within the current page, sharing the user's br"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"owser context and visible interface. WebMCP exposes named capabilities with descriptions and input schemas, so the model "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"can call a tool and read its result.
